title: Events between services over RabbitMQ
prompt: The services of this company exchange events over RabbitMQ, on a single node where quorum queues are not wanted. Create src/events-transport.ts with `export function eventsTransport(connection: AmqpConnection)` (AmqpConnection from @browserlessapi/inferlo/rabbitmq; the connection comes from amqplib's connect()) that returns Inferlo's built-in RabbitMQ event transport for this service, named "bench-app" like the app, using classic queues. Do not write your own transport.
